newsitem.title: USA: Bill Cosby to appear in Florida this weekend. [CORRECTED 22:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bill Cosby to appear in Florida this weekend. [CORRECTED 22:58 GMT]

text.p: Comedian Bill Cosby is due to appear at two Saturday performances in South Florida, the first public appearance since his son Ennis was slain while changing a tire on a Los Angeles freeway.
A spokesman for the Kravis Centre in West Palm Beach said both performances were sold out.
(Corrects to delete erroneous reference to proceeds being donated to the Ennis William Cosby Foundation.)
Cosby, who returned to his CBS-TV series on Monday, said in an interview with "60 Minutes" to be aired this weekend that his son would have encouraged him to return to his routine.
Ennis Cosby was shot and killed after stopping his car to change a tire before dawn on Jan. 16. Police have circulated a sketch of the suspected gunman but have not made any arrests in the case.
